## User story

**As a** developer preparing a repeatable heat-analysis demonstration,
**I want** industrial, residential and park aerial presets available locally and in configured object storage,
**so that** I can exercise contrasting surfaces without obtaining third-party imagery.

## Acceptance criteria

**AC1 — Three distinguishable local scenes**
Given the seeder is run from either the repository root or another working directory,
when generation completes,
then repository-root `data_samples/` contains RGB industrial asphalt, mixed residential and green park images with distinguishable content.

**AC2 — Optional cloud copies**
Given `GCS_BUCKET_NAME` is configured and uploads succeed,
when the generated scenes are uploaded,
then all three objects exist under `samples/` in that bucket and the returned storage URIs identify them.

**AC3 — Offline operation**
Given the bucket is unset or authentication or upload fails,
when the seeder runs,
then it warns safely, retains all local scenes and does not fail solely because of unavailable cloud storage.

## Tasks

- [x] Generate three distinct RGB Pillow scenes without external assets
- [x] Resolve output paths against the repository root, not the working directory
- [x] Upload optionally under `samples/` using environment-selected bucket configuration
- [x] Cache the Storage client lazily and handle cloud failures with safe warnings
- [x] Cover local generation, uploads, missing credentials and checksum failures offline

## Current state

Delivered. The seeder writes `industrial_hotspot.jpg`, `mixed_residential.jpg` and `cool_park.jpg`, returns local paths, and performs optional best-effort uploads. It catches specific cloud, authentication, request and checksum failures while retaining files. [tests/test_seed_samples.py](../../../tests/test_seed_samples.py) verifies the three scenes and cloud-degradation paths with mocks.

The older epic's two-image and missing-upload descriptions no longer apply. Uploaded scan retention belongs to STORY-031, not this sample-generation workflow.

## Test cases

| Test                                                           | Asserts                                                                |
| -------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `test_three_distinguishable_scenes_are_written`                | Three distinct RGB scenes exist at the repository-relative destination |
| `test_three_blobs_upload_under_samples_prefix`                 | All sample objects use the configured bucket and prefix                |
| `test_unset_bucket_warns_skips_uploads_and_writes_local_files` | Offline generation preserves all local files                           |
| `test_upload_failure_warns_and_continues`                      | Cloud failure warns without discarding generated scenes                |
| `test_missing_credentials_warn_and_retain_local_files`         | Absent credentials do not prevent local use                            |

## Definition of done

All three criteria pass offline with mocked Storage, local generation remains working-directory independent, logs are safe under the [GCP service instructions](../../instructions/gcp-services.instructions.md), and coverage does not regress below the 70% floor.
